prompt:
Create one clean transparent animation keyframe of this cheerful fantasy raccoon game mascot, Doguri. Use the exact same character design and painted 2D sprite style as the reference: a big pink head, burgundy raccoon mask, white eye ring, red apple with green leaf on its head, tiny round pink torso, stubby pink arms and legs, burgundy paws, and a purple-grey and white striped tail with a green tip. The mascot faces RIGHT in the same side camera. Keep the full mascot, apple, tail and both paws visible, with empty space around it. No text, ground, glow, colored haze or shadow. Output a single sprite, not a sheet, on a 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas.
This is the airborne phase immediately before its farther foot lands while running to the right. The bigger foreground leg reaches BACK toward the LEFT under the tail; its knee bends and its paw stays in the air. The smaller background leg reaches FORWARD toward the RIGHT, its bent knee and paw clearly visible ahead. Both short legs remain fully attached and clearly distinguishable. The visible foreground arm reaches FORWARD RIGHT across the front of its torso, as in the reference. The background arm reaches back left. Keep its original squat, very short-limbed cartoon proportions. Both paws are lifted above an imaginary floor: leave about 80 pixels of clear air beneath both soles before the imaginary floor at y=950. Do not draw that floor. This is a playful running keyframe with changing limb joints, not a shifted copy of a standing pose. Keep the apple leaf pointing upper right and the same overhead-left light.
